import os,re,json
from collections import Counter

def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
I=G['Demo pair 1 input']; O=G['Demo pair 1 output']
I2=G['Demo pair 2 input']; O2=G['Demo pair 2 output']
T=G['Test input']

def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(v for r in g for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    ts=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==3]
    trs=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==2]
    o=[row[:] for row in g]
    rs={r for r,c in ts}; cs={c for r,c in ts}
    ctr=sum(t[0] for t in trs)/len(trs); ctc=sum(t[1] for t in trs)/len(trs)
    def cheb(p): return max(abs(p[0]-ctr),abs(p[1]-ctc))
    def free(a,b): return 0<=a<H and 0<=b<W and g[a][b]==bg
    def fwd_is_2(a,b): return 0<=a<H and 0<=b<W and g[a][b]==2
    orient='V' if len(rs)==1 else 'H'
    if orient=='V':
        dc=0; dr=1 if min(t[0] for t in trs)>=min(rs) else -1
        start=ts[-1] if dr>0 else ts[0]
    else:
        dr=0; dc=1 if min(t[1] for t in trs)>=min(cs) else -1
        start=min(ts) if dc>0 else max(ts)
    r,c=start; curr=(dr,dc)
    # paint the whole starting seed pair as 3 (already 3)
    for s in ts: o[s[0]][s[1]]=3
    while True:
        na,nb=r+curr[0],c+curr[1]
        if fwd_is_2(na,nb): break      # stop adjacent to 2, don't overwrite
        if not free(na,nb):           # blocked -> turn
            perp={(1,0),(-1,0)} if curr[1]!=0 else {(0,1),(0,-1)}
            best=None
            for dd in perp:
                na2,nb2=r+dd[0],c+dd[1]
                if 0<=na2<H and 0<=nb2<W and g[na2][nb2]==bg:
                    key=cheb((na2,nb2)); cand=((key,(na2,nb2),dd))
                    if best is None or cand<best: best=cand
            if best is None: break
            _,_,dd=best
            r,c=r+dd[0],c+dd[1]; curr=dd; continue
        r,c=na,nb; curr=curr
        o[r][c]=3
    return o

print('demo1:', f(I)==O)
print('demo2:', f(I2)==O2)
out=f(T)

import os,glob,re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
# gather demos
for n in ['1','2','3']:
    I=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; O=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for row in I for x in row)
    marks=[(r,c,I[r][c]) for r in range(len(I)) for c in range(len(I[0])) if I[r][c] not in (min(cnt,key=lambda k:cnt[k]),)]
    # bg = majority, walls = rest? find bg as most common, walls = least common? report colors
    vals=sorted(cnt.items(), key=lambda kv:-kv[1])
    print(f'--- demo{n}: shapes{[(c,v) for c,v in vals]} marks{marks}')

from collections import Counter
def solve(I):
    H=len(I);W=len(I[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for row in I for x in row); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    ms=[(r,c,I[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if cnt[I[r][c]]==2]
    tr=min(r for r,_,_ in ms); br=max(r for r,_,_ in ms)
    tcells=sorted(c for r,c,_ in ms if r==tr); bcells=sorted(c for r,c,_ in ms if r==br)
    cand=[c for c in range(W) if all(I[r][c]==bg for r in range(tr+1,br))]
    cr=cand[0]  # leftmost fully-clear corridor column
    out=[row[:] for row in I]
    def mark(r,c,v):
        if 0<=r<H and 0<=c<W and out[r][c]==bg: out[r][c]=v
    # top arm: from nearest marker cell horizontally to cr
    tstart=tcells[-1] if cr<tcells[0] else tcells[0]
    for c in range(min(tstart,cr),max(tstart,cr)+1): mark(tr,c,3)
    bstart=bcells[-1] if cr<bcells[0] else bcells[0]
    for c in range(min(bstart,cr),max(bstart,cr)+1): mark(br,c,3)
    # vertical leg includes both endpoints, color of BOTTOM marker
    for r in range(tr,br+1): mark(r,cr,3)
    return out
for n,(I,O) in [('d2',(I2,O2)),('d3',(I3,O3))]:
    print(n,'match' if solve(I)==O else 'MISMATCH')
